## Background

"Know the rules well, so you can break them effectively." \~ [Dalai Lama](https://www.goodreads.com/quotes/629862-learn-and-obey-the-rules-very-well-so-you-will)

Perhaps more relevant to data visualization, this version of a similar idea is widely (though perhaps mistakenly) attributed to Pablo Picasso: "Learn the rules like a pro, so you can break them like an artist."[^task_15_ugly_graph_contest-1]

This assignment will test whether you are a data artist, by challenging you to break as many "design rules" as possible.

## Task

Use a previous graph or create a new one. (The [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/) website has data.) Use as many themes as needed to make it as ugly as possible.

The requirements are:

1.  It must be turned in on time.

<!-- -->

1.  It must be recognizable as a graph

2.  Render your `.qmd` file. Push all the files created in the rendering process into your GitHub repository.

### Submit

In I-learn submit the link to your `html` file hosted on your repo's GitHub pages.
:::
